name: Boris Nagaev
cooked: jijizudi, you are right, the comparison to P2WPKH was done on a depth-1 EC leaf. I think this makes sense, since EC leaf is the leaf that will be used normally (or in cooperative cases if the coin is a multisig) until the Q day. So it makes sense to optimize the tree and put it closer the the root (i.e. depth-1).
